programmes.d: Karl ventures down into the cellars of this large country house and soon comes under attack from an unseen force.

In this episode, Karl investigates the courtroom of one of Dorchester’s oldest buildings. As he explores alone, he finds himself suddenly surrounded by mysterious and unexplained activity, making it a tense and unnerving experience.

Underneath Dorchester Shire Hall lies a maze of tunnels and old prison cells said to be haunted by restless spirits. Stuart ventures alone into the underground, where unsettling presences make themselves known in chilling fashion.

At the York Castle Museum, Karl enters a recreation of historic streets and former prison cells. The building’s long and eerie history is matched only by the intensity of paranormal activity captured during this dramatic investigation.

Yvette takes Karl, Stuart, and Mary into the massive and foreboding Shrewsbury Prison. Known for its dark history and intense hauntings, the team faces an overwhelming mix of unexplained phenomena in one of the UK’s most haunted locations.

Yvette and Glen explore the Hack Green Nuclear Bunker, built on ancient, storied land and long associated with paranormal activity. Their solo investigation quickly turns unsettling as they come face-to-face with the bunker’s dark secrets.

Gloucester Prison is a sprawling complex with many haunted zones. Karl ventures into a particularly active block, where spirits are often reported. Alone in the dark, he soon realizes he’s not the only one there.

Beloved actor, Ernie Hudson returns to the remote mountain lodge in Arizona where he and his family encountered a terrifying supernatural force during the promotion of the original Ghostbusters movie.
Actress and glamour icon, Morgan Fairchild seeks closure on the haunting events, both real and paranormal, that drove her from her ex-husband's home in Dallas more than 40 years ago.
In this episode, Beverley Mitchell ("7th Heaven") returns to Pennhurst Asylum to find answers about the ghosts at Pennhurst.
For the first time in years, Eric Mabius (Resident Evil, Ugly Betty) returns to Allaire Village to confront the ghost.
Connie and her daughter Joely Fisher have shared their home with a ghost for a long time. Kim accompanies both women.
Kim Russo accompanies her on this journey and explains why Kelly has attracted these spirits.
Joan Osborne is attacked by the ghost of a woman with a painful history.
Chaka Khan is saved by a guardian angel; Kristin Bauer comes face to face with the spirit of her father; and Iqbal Theba is terrorized by a demonic spirit.
A dedicated psychic puts his reputation on the line to track down two con men in Scotland.
A serial killer is loose in Baton Rouge, police believe they’re looking for a youngish white man driving a white pick up truck.
Twenty-five year old Jacqueline Poole is assaulted and strangled in her home. The police find her body 48 hours later and launch their investigation.
Mark Green disappears one night without a trace. Police are stumped. There is no evidence. Diane Lazarus, a psychic in a nearby town, is holding a reading.
Lawrence Mbroh was in a dangerous business - he sold drugs. So when he disappears, his father Alfred is worried. Detective Pam Gray is investigating the case but can find no new leads.
Can a psychic lead police to a body so they can convict a cold-blooded killer? Rosa Talamantes goes out for a drink with her boyfriend and never returns.
In small town Ohio, a respected state trooper reports his wife missing. Then he tells the police she’s run off with a secret lover. But has she?
In Thomaston Georgia, when local roofer Thomas Bragg is found murdered in his bed, the whole town is talking. The police suspect his wife, but they have no witnesses, no leads and no murder weapon.
When popular high school student Robert Piest disappears after his shift at a local drugstore, police in Des Plaines, Illinois, ask psychic Carol Broman for help.
On July 1st 1996, 36-year-old Diana Goldston is abducted by a burly man in a pick-up truck in broad daylight outside the Denton, Texas bar where she sells flowers.
When wealthy Arizona businesswoman, Loretta Bowersock, vanishes on a shopping trip to Tucson, her charming partner claims she’s been abducted.
When Laura-Ann Beyerly vanishes without a trace, her parents immediately file a missing persons report. Her mother senses that something is wrong.
When a swimming instructor, Mae Wentz, is brutally stabbed to death in her Boynton Beach home, Florida police comb the bloody crime scene for clues.
When New Jersey single mother Nicole Arochas vanishes after a night on the town, her parents suspect the worst and file a missing persons report.
When 20-year-old Kim Antonakos disappears after a late night out in Manhattan, her father files a missing persons report.
When Mildred ‘Miss Louise’ Williams disappears from her small Maryland town, local police don’t take the case seriously.
A Pennsylvania factory-town is terrified when Dr. John Yelenic, a much-loved, local dentist is found murdered in his home.
A recent Harvard grad, 23-year-old Laura Houghteling, has just moved home to begin a promising new career as a Washington, D.C. lawyer.
When a 31-year-old nurse and single mother, Melanie Uribe, is carjacked in an L.A. suburb, police find her burned out truck the same night, but no trace of the victim.
